name: Minth Group Limited
summary: Minth Group Limited, an investment holding company, designs, develops, manufactures, processes, and sells automobile body parts and moulds of passenger cars. The company manufactures, develops, and sells motor systems for electric vehicles, as well as metal molds, automobile body parts; automobile body parts manufacturing equipment, automation machines, software, production lines, and automobile drives; and offers bookkeeping services.
